prompt: Elements `[4, 10, 3, 5, 1]` are placed into an array and converted into a Min-Heap using Floyd's bottom-up buildHeap algorithm. Which array representation satisfies the min-heap parent-child invariant `A[i] <= A[2i+1]` and `A[i] <= A[2i+2]`?
explanation: A valid binary min-heap must satisfy A[i] <= children for every parent. Bottom-up heapify rearranges `[4, 10, 3, 5, 1]` to `[1, 4, 3, 5, 10]`.
